excerpt_i18n.en: Currently, artificial intelligence (AI) is deeply integrating into the investment processes of capital markets, serving as a core driver for the transformation and upgrading of the private equity industry. According to industry sources, subjective strategy stock private equity firms, which previously relied on in-depth research and experience-based judgment for operations, are now accelerating the adoption of AI technology to enhance fund managers' capital management capacity and research coverage boundaries. Many subjective strategy private equity firms have already broken the traditional notion that "AI is only suitable for quantitative investing." Industry insiders believe that the penetration rate of AI in the subjective strategy private equity sector will continue to rise, not only empowering traditional private equity institutions but also potentially giving rise to entirely new forms of private equity entities. (Securities Times)
excerpt_i18n.es: Actualmente, la inteligencia artificial (IA) se está integrando profundamente en los procesos de inversión del mercado de capitales, convirtiéndose en el motor central de la transformación y actualización de la industria de fondos de inversión privados. Según información del sector, los fondos de inversión privados de estrategia subjetiva, que antes operaban basándose en investigaciones profundas y juicios empíricos, ahora están acelerando la adopción de tecnología de IA para ampliar el radio de gestión de capital y el alcance de investigación de los gestores de fondos. Muchos fondos de estrategia subjetiva ya han superado la idea preconcebida de que "la IA solo es adecuada para la inversión cuantitativa". Los expertos del sector consideran que la penetración de la IA en el ámbito de los fondos de estrategia subjetiva seguirá aumentando, lo que no solo potenciará a las instituciones tradicionales de fondos privados, sino que incluso podría dar lugar a nuevas formas de entidades de fondos privados. (Securities Times)

In June 2026, the Beijing Zhiyuan Conference will commence. For attendees of large academic conferences, the dense schedule of parallel forums, overlapping major topics, and limited opportunities for expert interaction often create a dilemma of "too much to hear, too few sessions to attend, and no chance to ask follow-up questions." To address this high-density knowledge scenario, Zhiyuan will officially launch a personal exclusive intelligent agent, SoulAgent, offering attendees a brand-new intelligent conference experience.

SoulAgent is not just a one-time Q&A tool but an AI companion that continuously grows through long-term interaction, becoming more attuned to users over time. During this year's Zhiyuan Conference, SoulAgent will accompany attendees throughout the event, supporting synchronized listening across multiple venues, helping users track content from various forums in real time, and recording, summarizing, and extracting key insights. Additionally, SoulAgent will integrate avatars of 11 top AI experts, enabling users to engage in multi-round dialogues on cutting-edge ideas, research directions, and technical issues, transforming frontier exchanges from one-way listening into two-way interaction.

During this year's Zhiyuan Conference, 25 forums and special events will be held intensively. Facing the scenario of multiple parallel forums and high information density, SoulAgent will help users acquire information more efficiently, understand content, and consolidate knowledge pathways. Its expert AI avatar capability will also provide users with a more sustained entry point for professional exchanges, allowing questions from speeches, doubts in papers, and thoughts on research directions to be further explored, deconstructed, and expanded.

Author | Wu You    Editor | Liu Wei  

"Smart rings are still a niche market globally, with annual sales of a few million units, but I believe they will eventually catch up with smartwatches and achieve global sales of hundreds of millions." Professor Wang Guoxing, a distinguished professor at Shanghai Jiao Tong University and founder of the RingConn brand, shared his outlook on the future of smart rings on May 30 at the INNO100 Global Innovation Flagship Store in Shenzhen.  

That day marked the product launch of the RingConn Gen3. Professor Wang, dressed in a light green shirt and wearing three smart rings, attended the event to introduce the new-generation AI smart ring to tech enthusiasts and users.  

Compared to the Gen2, the Gen3 focuses on three key upgrades:  

First, long-term blood pressure trend insights, enabled by clinically validated automatic monitoring every 15 minutes to reflect real vascular load. It also provides comprehensive vascular health analysis and personalized improvements based on load factors such as sleep, exercise, circadian rhythm, and daily vascular stability.  

Second, the industry's first micro-awakening recognition, which captures brief, unnoticed awakenings during sleep, offering a more accurate reflection of fatigue and sleep quality.  

Third, the addition of AI-powered health vibration alerts, supporting proactive intervention in scenarios such as abnormal heart rate, prolonged sitting, high stress, headaches, fever, and dehydration.  

Additionally, the Gen3 features a parallel stacked architecture with seven sensors and a VCSEL infrared solution, along with a patented ergonomic design combining a circular interior and square exterior.
